A muscle relaxant is a drug that affects skeletal muscle function

The term `` muscle relaxant '' is used to refer to two major therapeutic groups
two major therapeutic groups : neuromuscular blockers and spasmolytics
Neuromuscular blockers act by interfering with transmission at the neuromuscular end plate
Neuromuscular blockers act by interfering with transmission at the neuromuscular end plate and have no central nervous system ( CNS ) activity

The phrase `` objects in ( the ) mirror are closer than they appear '' is a safety warning
is a safety warning that is required to be engraved on passenger side mirrors of motor vehicles
is a safety warning that is required to be engraved on passenger side mirrors of motor vehicles in the USA , Canada , Nepal , India and Saudi Arabia
It is present because while these mirrors ' convexity gives them a useful field of view
while these mirrors ' convexity gives them a useful field of view , it also makes objects appear smaller
Since smaller - appearing objects seem farther away than they actually are
a driver might make a maneuver such as a lane change assuming an adjacent vehicle is a safe distance behind
a driver might make a maneuver such as a lane change assuming an adjacent vehicle is a safe distance behind , when in fact it is quite a bit closer
The warning serves as a reminder to the driver of this potential problem
